name: Bevy
description: A data-driven game engine built in Rust.
summary: Bevy permits careful, disclosed, human-driven AI assistance in some code-related contributions, but contributors must understand and take responsibility for what they submit, and only humans may be commit authors. AI-generated issue text, documentation, PR descriptions, release notes and other public prose are prohibited.

evidence.quote: Disclosure. Any use of AI to contribute to Bevy must be disclosed, with context about how it was used.

Ownership. As a contributor, you are responsible for everything you submit. You must personally understand every line of code or documentation that you put forward for review, and be able to articulate the design rationale and implementation tradeoffs when asked.
No AI-authored commits. Only humans can be commit authors or listed as Co-authored-by.
No AI-generated prose. AI must not be used to write public-facing prose, including documentation, issues, PR descriptions, or release notes.
